# Multi-Sensor: one writer, many sensors

**Status:** program registered 2026-08-08, before anything runs. Franci's
direction: single-block conditioning is limiting; the goal is a
multi-sensor combination that works.

**Why this is not already refuted.** Every composition failure in the
program shares one structure: independently-trained writers merged
post-hoc. Paper 7 killed additive weight-space merges; paper 9 killed
shared-budget activation merges and cross-channel superposition (dominance,
never coexistence); paper 10 killed recall×presence in one utterance at 4B
(mode exclusion, P(joint=0) ~ 6e-9). None of them tested (a) **one writer
reading many sensors** — a single bridge conditioned on N modalities
emitting one delta, so there is no write-collision to lose — or (b)
**presence×presence** joint behavior: "it's night AND the battery is low"
is one mode with two contents, and the mode exclusion was measured on
past+present, not present+present. The composable-dual archive holds the
program's only positive composition result (split-input bridge, different
modalities into one bridge) and the principle that bridge conditioning
wants

[tracks/multi-sensor/PLAN.md chunk 1 of 0-5]
, plus per-lane rates.

**Reading.** These are floors, not results. Everything later must beat
the best of them strictly or it is not a finding. If additive merge
already joint-heeds at 4B under the joint-presence surface, papers 7/9
said something narrower than we think, and that is itself the finding.

## M0 result (2026-08-08) — the floors are zero, both venues

**Joint-heed is 0.000 in every registered cell at 27B, and 0.000 in all
but one at 4B** — the one being the `vitals+imu` additive merge at 0.167
(2/12), which does not reproduce at 27B. Solo blocks score no joint
credit structurally, the paper-7 merge cell stays dead in-band, the
prompt-only language floor is zero, and the oracle router's ceiling is
zero because selection can only ever surface one lane. Artifacts
`findings/multi-sensor-m0-{4b,27b}.*`; the composition banks validated
joint-positive at every pair (10-12 rows each), ready for M1 training.
Wall: 60 s at 4B, 183 s at 27B; sha256-pinned checkpoints (the 4B March
vintage, the 27B r2 column); services restored and verified after each
block. **Reading: the floor to beat is any nonzero joint-heed with
per-lane retention

# Embodied Simulation

**Status:** CPU scaffold and sensor-separability gate implemented  
**Scope:** MuJoCo physics, per-segment IMU, and offscreen RGB only

## What this is

A 1–4 joint tabletop planar arm. Every physical segment has its own MuJoCo
accelerometer, gyroscope, and orientation sensor. Random-body mode seeds link
count, lengths, hinge signs, and action-slot ordering so body configuration must
be discovered rather than supplied as labels.

## API contract

- `MujocoArmSim.reset(...)`, `step(...)`, and `get_state()` run at 50 Hz.
- Actions are clipped to `[-1, 1]`; each motor scales them by its joint torque limit.
- `servo_states` is joint-order `[angle, velocity, target]`; two-joint states
  retain the older shoulder/elbow and wrist-FK fields.
- `segment_imu` is `(segments, 9, 128)` float32, normalized with the existing
  UCI-HAR IMU checkpoint statistics. `segment_imu_raw` is the same layout in
  g/rad·s⁻¹: body acceleration, gyro, total acceleration.
- `CameraSim.render()` returns an RGB `uint8` frame.

## What it unblocks

- `segment-imu`: genuine local signals instead of one ambiguous wrist signal.
- `body-schema`: acti

# Embodied Simulation

**Status:** CPU scaffold and sensor-separability gate implemented  
**Scope:** MuJoCo physics, per-segment IMU, and offscreen RGB only

## What this is

A 1–4 joint tabletop planar arm. Every physical segment has its own MuJoCo
accelerometer, gyroscope, and orientation sensor. Random-body mode seeds link
count, lengths, hinge signs, and action-slot ordering so body configuration must
be discovered rather than supplied as labels.

## API contract

- `MujocoArmSim.reset(...)`, `step(...)`, and `get_state()` run at 50 Hz.
- Actions are clipped to `[-1, 1]`; each motor scales them by its joint torque limit.
- `servo_states` is joint-order `[angle, velocity, target]`; two-joint states
  retain the older shoulder/elbow and wrist-FK fields.
- `segment_imu` is `(segments, 9, 128)` float32, normalized with the existing
  UCI-HAR IMU checkpoint statistics. `segment_imu_raw` is the same layout in
  g/rad·s⁻¹: body acceleration, gyro, total acceleration.
- `CameraSim.render()` returns an RGB `uint8` frame.

## What it unblocks

- `segment-imu`: genuine local signals instead of one ambiguous wrist signal.

# Embodied Simulation

**Status:** CPU scaffold and sensor-separability gate implemented  
**Scope:** MuJoCo physics, per-segment IMU, and offscreen RGB only

## What this is

A 1–4 joint tabletop planar arm. Every physical segment has its own MuJoCo
accelerometer, gyroscope, and orientation sensor. Random-body mode seeds link
count, lengths, hinge signs, and action-slot ordering so body configuration must
be discovered rather than supplied as labels.

## API contract

- `MujocoArmSim.reset(...)`, `step(...)`, and `get_state()` run at 50 Hz.
- Actions are clipped to `[-1, 1]`; each motor scales them by its joint torque limit.
- `servo_states` is joint-order `[angle, velocity, target]`; two-joint states
  retain the older shoulder/elbow and wrist-FK fields.
- `segment_imu` is `(segments, 9, 128)` float32, normalized with the existing
  UCI-HAR IMU checkpoint statistics. `segment_imu_raw` is the same layout in
  g/rad·s⁻¹: body acceleration, gyro, total acceleration.
- `CameraSim.render()` returns an RGB `uint8` frame.

## What it unblocks

- `segment-imu`: genuine local signals instead of one ambiguous wrist signal.
- `body-schema`: acti

# Embodied Simulation

**Status:** CPU scaffold and sensor-separability gate implemented  
**Scope:** MuJoCo physics, per-segment IMU, and offscreen RGB only

## What this is

A 1–4 joint tabletop planar arm. Every physical segment has its own MuJoCo
accelerometer, gyroscope, and orientation sensor. Random-body mode seeds link
count, lengths, hinge signs, and action-slot ordering so body configuration must
be discovered rather than supplied as labels.

## API contract

- `MujocoArmSim.reset(...)`, `step(...)`, and `get_state()` run at 50 Hz.
- Actions are clipped to `[-1, 1]`; each motor scales them by its joint torque limit.
- `servo_states` is joint-order `[angle, velocity, target]`; two-joint states
  retain the older shoulder/elbow and wrist-FK fields.
- `segment_imu` is `(segments, 9, 128)` float32, normalized with the existing
  UCI-HAR IMU checkpoint statistics. `segment_imu_raw` is the same layout in
  g/rad·s⁻¹: body acceleration, gyro, total acceleration.
- `CameraSim.render()` returns an RGB `uint8` frame.

## What it unblocks

- `segment-imu`: genuine local signals instead of one ambiguous wrist signal.
- `body-schema`: acti

## Architecture contract

- Source and target see separate prompts.
- The source final prompt activation is detached.
- `RMS normalize -> Linear -> GELU -> Linear` forms the learned bus.
- Training-set source centering removes the common prompt component.
- A disposable supervised packet head prevents constant-packet collapse. It is
  used only as an auxiliary training loss; runtime still uses emitter and
  receiver alone.
- The receiver output is normalized and added to the target's final prompt
  position as a bounded fraction of the native residual norm.
- A zero dose is an exact identity.
- Prompt-prefill injection happens once. Downstream native target cache state
  carries the intervention into autoregressive generation.
- No KV tensor is shared.

## Architecture contract

- Source and target see separate prompts.
- The source final prompt activation is detached.
- `RMS normalize -> Linear -> GELU -> Linear` forms the learned bus.
- Training-set source centering removes the common prompt component.
- A disposable supervised packet head prevents constant-packet collapse. It is
  used only as an auxiliary training loss; runtime still uses emitter and
  receiver alone.
- The receiver output is normalized and added to the target's final prompt
  position as a bounded fraction of the native residual norm.
- A zero dose is an exact identity.
- Prompt-prefill injection happens once. Downstream native target cache state
  carries the intervention into autoregressive generation.
- No KV tensor is shared.

## Architecture contract

- Source and target see separate prompts.
- The source final prompt activation is detached.
- `RMS normalize -> Linear -> GELU -> Linear` forms the learned bus.
- Training-set source centering removes the common prompt component.
- A disposable supervised packet head prevents constant-packet collapse. It is
  used only as an auxiliary training loss; runtime still uses emitter and
  receiver alone.
- The receiver output is normalized and added to the target's final prompt
  position as a bounded fraction of the native residual norm.
- A zero dose is an exact identity.
- Prompt-prefill injection happens once. Downstream native target cache state
  carries the intervention into autoregressive generation.
- No KV tensor is shared.

## Architecture contract

- Source and target see separate prompts.
- The source final prompt activation is detached.
- `RMS normalize -> Linear -> GELU -> Linear` forms the learned bus.
- Training-set source centering removes the common prompt component.
- A disposable supervised packet head prevents constant-packet collapse. It is
  used only as an auxiliary training loss; runtime still uses emitter and
  receiver alone.
- The receiver output is normalized and added to the target's final prompt
  position as a bounded fraction of the native residual norm.
- A zero dose is an exact identity.
- Prompt-prefill injection happens once. Downstream native target cache state
  carries the intervention into autoregressive generation.
- No KV tensor is shared.

## Architecture contract

- Source and target see separate prompts.
- The source final prompt activation is detached.
- `RMS normalize -> Linear -> GELU -> Linear` forms the learned bus.
- Training-set source centering removes the common prompt component.
- A disposable supervised packet head prevents constant-packet collapse. It is
  used only as an auxiliary training loss; runtime still uses emitter and
  receiver alone.
- The receiver output is normalized and added to the target's final prompt
  position as a bounded fraction of the native residual norm.
- A zero dose is an exact identity.
- Prompt-prefill injection happens once. Downstream native target cache state
  carries the intervention into autoregressive generation.
- No KV tensor is shared.

## Architecture contract

- Source and target see separate prompts.
- The source final prompt activation is detached.
- `RMS normalize -> Linear -> GELU -> Linear` forms the learned bus.
- Training-set source centering removes the common prompt component.
- A disposable supervised packet head prevents constant-packet collapse. It is
  used only as an auxiliary training loss; runtime still uses emitter and
  receiver alone.
- The receiver output is normalized and added to the target's final prompt
  position as a bounded fraction of the native residual norm.
- A zero dose is an exact identity.
- Prompt-prefill injection happens once. Downstream native target cache state
  carries the intervention into autoregressive generation.
- No KV tensor is shared.
